author: DistroTube
description:
Quarkos is a user friendly, desktop oriented operating system based on Ubuntu Linux with Plasma, optionally Trinity desktop environment, and an added value thanks to unique Q4OS tools integrated. Its goal is to provide Ubuntu based operating system with Q4OS amenities. Unlike Q4OS, which is Debian based, Quarkos is based on Ubuntu.
